kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
أقتعد (form VIII)
# أَقْتَعِدُ (ʔaqtaʕidu) /ʔaq.ta.ʕi.du/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# أُقْتَعَدُ (ʔuqtaʕadu) /ʔuq.ta.ʕa.du/: first-person singular non-past passive indicative of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# أَقْتَعِدَ (ʔaqtaʕida) /ʔaq.ta.ʕi.da/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِقْتَعَدَ (iqtaʕada)
# أُقْتَعَدَ (ʔuqtaʕada) /ʔuq.ta.ʕa
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
